definitions.explanation: the act of moving into a new residence, apartment, or facility

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{入居|にゅうきょ}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I'm scheduled to move in next month.

examples.japanese: このマンションは{入居|にゅうきょ}{率|りつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This apartment building has a high occupancy rate.

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}マンションへの{入居|にゅうきょ}{開始|かいし}は{来年|らいねん}の{春|はる}になる。
examples.english: Move-ins to the new condominium will begin next spring.

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- {退去|たいきょ} - moving out (opposite)
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し - moving (relocating in general)
- {転居|てんきょ} - changing residence

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{審査|しんさ} - tenant screening
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{率|りつ} - occupancy rate
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{条件|じょうけん} - move-in conditions/requirements
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{者|しゃ} - resident, tenant
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{可能|かのう} - move-in ready

USAGE:
Used for apartments, condominiums, nursing homes, dormitories, and other residential facilities. For nursing homes and care facilities, {入居|にゅうきょ} emphasizes taking up residence rather than admission ({入院|にゅういん}).
